verdict.rationale: Epic's license documentation confirms full source-code access and 'all platforms & features,' meaning Unreal Engine can be built and run entirely on a user's own machines/infrastructure without dependence on Epic's cloud services, satisfying the core self-hosting requirement. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the self-hosting workflow, and clarity on how the revenue-based EULA (noted by community as having 'a lot of strings attached') constrains true open self-hosting/openness beyond source access.
